METALWORK — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.

4. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.

7. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

9. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.

10. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

11. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.

12. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.

13. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

14. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

15. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Project 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Gas Welding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Forging and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Finishing Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
